name: Hiên web density
usage: The web CMS is used with a mouse on a wide screen, for long sessions of tables and forms: the touch sizes of tokens.json made it large and heavy. These values replace the type, radius and size scales of tokens.json in the web outputs only (tokens.css, theme.css); the apps keep the canvas values. The added colors and shadows go to every output (DOC-54 §5.5, DR-307); `theme` recolors canvas tokens on the web only (DR-311).

theme.usage: Canvas colors and shadows the web draws differently (DR-311): a light neutral grey ground, without the canvas's green tint, that the sidebar and top bar share, so the white cards stand out from it; neutral fills and dividers to match; a slightly brighter teal, the one color of the brand. A token not named keeps its canvas value; `success*` follow the `teal*` they alias. Only `tokens.css` reads them; the apps keep the canvas.

color.name: line-control
color.usage: Border of a text input, select and checkbox on the web: the lightest border that keeps 3:1 on `surface` and `ground`. Hover and focus take `line-strong`. A button or chip, which its text names, takes `line`.

color.name: line-input
color.usage: Border of a text input, select, text area, checkbox and radio on the web, and the track of an unchecked switch, after shadcn's `border-input`: a light edge, since the field is told by its label, its white fill and `shadow-field`; focus turns it `teal` with the `shadow-focus` ring (DR-311, revises DR-307's 3:1 field border).

color.name: surface-muted
color.usage: A band inside a `surface` card on the web: the table header, the hovered row, the footer of a dialog. A step from `surface` toward `ground`, so the band reads as part of the card (DR-311).

shadow.name: shadow-raised
shadow.usage: An outline button, a text input, a chip or a chosen segment on the web: a hairline lift under a 1 px border.

shadow.name: shadow-panel
shadow.usage: A card, a table card or the active entry of the sidebar on `ground` (web): layered blur under a 1 px `line` border, so a card rises from the ground (DR-311).

shadow.name: shadow-primary
shadow.usage: A `primary` button and the brand mark on the web: a light top edge and a teal glow beneath (DR-311).

shadow.name: shadow-field
shadow.usage: A text input, select, text area, OTP cell, checkbox or radio on the web: shadcn's `shadow-xs` under its 1 px `line-input` border, the same for every field (DR-311).

shadow.name: shadow-focus
shadow.usage: The focus of a field on the web (a focused text input, text area, checkbox, radio, OTP input, an open select): a 3 px `teal` ring outside its border, which turns `teal`, after shadcn's `ring-[3px]` (DR-311).

shadow.name: shadow-invalid
shadow.usage: A field in error on the web, at rest and focused: a 3 px `danger` ring outside its `danger` border, after shadcn's `aria-invalid` ring; the error is also written under the field (DR-311).
